a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan of operating up to 8 cells (at least 2 rounds) will very likely end with both of us at 0. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough to save one of us right now. I don't want to break our agreement behind your back, so I'm raising it openly. Do you want to renegotiate, for example by deciding who takes the 4 now, or do you want to stick with operating? Tell me your plan and I'll tell you mine before acting.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep our agreement and operate with you until the reserve reaches 8, then we take 4 each. No early taking from me.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
